U-0001.summary: Build at C++20: rename the functions named concept and requires, drop the u8 literal, make Range an aggregate again, make Version's comparisons const, capture this explicitly, replace the removed binders, negators and function-object bases with lambdas, std::not_fn and std::mem_fn, remove register, and keep shuffled() deterministic per seed.
review_notes: Public API: toolkit::concept and toolkit::requires are now toolkit::isConcept and toolkit::requiredLevel, since both names are C++20 keywords; the test calls were renamed with them.

The clang-tidy codemod replaced std::random_shuffle(first, last, rng) with std::shuffle and a std::random_device-seeded std::mt19937, which ignored the seeded Lcg and made shuffled() nondeterministic (ShuffleTest.IsDeterministicPerSeed). shuffled() now runs the loop libc++'s random_shuffle ran with the Lcg, so a seed gives the same order as before with libc++; with libstdc++, whose random_shuffle walked the range differently, the order for a seed changes (the tests check only the permutation and determinism).
Range lost its defaulted constructor so that it stays an aggregate in C++20; Range r; still leaves low and high uninitialized, as before.
